title: Movies with Louis Armstrong
summary: He did "The Glenn Miller Story," "High Society," "The Five Pennies" and European films with Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: How many movies did you make with Louie?
Well, the first movie I did with Louie was "The Glenn Miller Story." I think I did three or four movies with Louie. I did several in Europe with Louie, European movies.
Oh, do you remember the names?

I remember one that we did -- we did with Nina and Frederick. I don't remember the name of it. You know that act -- Nina, the girl who was in -- who got mixed up with this guy who was supposed to have written Howard Hughes' --

She was married to this guy Frederick, and we did a movie with them in Copenhagen. I forgot the name of it, tell you the truth. And we also did one in Germany, "Kisses in the Nacht," that one in Germany, in Berlin.
Oh, I really don't know, Pat.
That's got me, but we did it -- it was in the late '50's, I'm pretty sure, it was around the late '50's. And in Italy we did a movie or two. But over here we did "The Glenn Miller Story" was

the first thing I did with Louis, and then we did "High Society", and the next one we did was the Red Nichols story of Five Pennies. And then he did something else, "The Beat Generation". It was a sad -- was a bad movie. I don't know what it was about. And he did something like that.
